'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Siege of Mariupol]]
****[[Ukraine]]'s chief military command orders all remaining troops in the [[Azovstal iron and steel works|Azovstal steel plant]] to stop defending [[Mariupol]]. [https://www.ledevoir.com/monde/713544/les-defenseurs-d-azovstal-ont-recu-l-ordre-de-kiev-d-arreter-de-combattre (AFP via ''Le Devoir'')] [https://news.sky.com/story/ukraine-war-last-ukrainian-troops-in-mariupol-told-to-stop-defence-of-city-12617385 (Sky News)]
****[[Russia]] says that [[Russian Ground Forces|its forces]] have seized the [[Azovstal iron and steel works|Azovstal steel plant]] after the last remaining Ukrainian troops surrender. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-61529877 (BBC News)]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Donbas offensive]]
****[[Ukraine]] says that it has repelled a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] advance on the cities of [[Sievierodonetsk]] and [[Lysychansk]] in [[Luhansk Oblast]]. Authorities say that twelve people were killed in the offensive and that over 60 houses were destroyed. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-kyiv-prisoners-of-war-71d0dfb842caaaad30b92671637c1f3b (AP)]
*[[Arab–Israeli conflict]], [[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Israeli–Syrian ceasefire line incidents during the Syrian civil war]]
***[[Syria]]n [[state media]] says that [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s have killed three soldiers close to [[Damascus]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/explosions-rock-syrian-capital-in-alleged-israeli-airstrikes/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Tigray War]]
**The [[Tigray People's Liberation Front]] announces it will release 4,028 [[Ethiopia]]n [[prisoners of war]] as part of the [[Tigrayan peace process]]. [https://apnews.com/article/politics-ethiopia-africa-kenya-prisoners-of-war-2c40c660ceaf9d0e323dec77acee9515 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Platinum Jubilee of Elizabeth II]]
**The [[Cabinet Office]] announces that eight [[United Kingdom|British]] towns will become [[City status in the United Kingdom|cities]] as part of [[Monarchy of the United Kingdom|Queen]] [[Elizabeth II]]'s Platinum Jubilee. The new cities are [[Milton Keynes]], [[Colchester]], and [[Doncaster]] in [[England]], [[Dunfermline]] in [[Scotland]], [[Wrexham]] in [[Wales]], and [[Bangor, County Down|Bangor]] in [[Northern Ireland]], as well as [[Stanley, Falkland Islands]], and [[Douglas, Isle of Man]], which become the first towns in the [[British Overseas Territories]] and the [[Crown Dependencies]], respectively, to receive city status. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-61505857 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Transport for London]] announces their intention to consult on an expansion of the [[Ultra Low Emission Zone]] to cover almost all of [[Greater London]] beginning on 23 August 2023. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-61515515 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tornadoes of 2022]]
**A [[tornado]] passes through the city of [[Paderborn]] in [[North Rhine-Westphalia]], [[Germany]], leaving a man dead and 43 injured and several buildings severely damaged. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-tornado-causes-major-damage-in-western-towns/a-61883911 (Deutsche Welle)]
**Two people are killed and 43 injured after a rare tornado hits the city of [[Gaylord, Michigan|Gaylord]], [[Michigan]], [[United States]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2022/05/20/gaylord-michigan-tornado-reports-injuries-damage/9864045002/ (''USA Today'')]
*Ten people are killed after a tunnel collapses in [[Ramban district]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-kashmir-tunnel-collapses-15bdab31cd2272b878ee04240907e732 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland]]
****[[First Minister of Scotland|Scottish First Minister]] [[Nicola Sturgeon]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-61530974.amp (BBC News)]
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] holds an [[emergency]] meeting in response to the recent [[monkeypox]] [[outbreak]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/2022/05/20/monkeypox-germany-france-first-case/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/world/article-who-calls-emergency-meeting-as-more-than-100-monkeypox-cases-confirmed/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]
**[[Spain]] confirms 30 monkeypox cases, becoming the country with the most reported cases. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20220520/8280789/viruela-mono-espana-pais-mas-casos.html (''La Vanguardia'')]
**[[Australia]] and [[Israel]] announce their first suspected cases of monkeypox, both in people who had recently travelled to [[Europe]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/australia-reports-probable-case-monkeypox-infection-2022-05-20/ (Reuters)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-reports-first-suspected-case-of-monkeypox-in-man-who-returned-from-europe/ (''Times of Israel'')]
**[[Germany]], [[France]], [[Belgium]], and the [[Netherlands]] confirm their first cases of monkeypox. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-france-belgium-confirm-first-cases-of-monkeypox/a-61865185 (Deutsche Welle)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/several-suspected-monkeypox-cases-netherlands-anp-citing-health-agency-2022-05-20/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[South China Sea dispute]]
**The [[Philippines]] says that it has established [[Philippine Coast Guard|coast guard]] [[Outpost (military)|outposts]] on three Filipino-controlled islands of the [[Spratlys]] in the [[South China Sea]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-beijing-philippines-manila-493bd445e580ebb133f55ecc4c0c5403 (AP)]
*[[2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute]], [[Finland–Russia relations]]
**[[Russia]] announces that it will suspend its supply of [[natural gas]] to [[Finland]] beginning at 4:00 [[Greenwich Mean Time|GMT]] tomorrow due to Finland's refusal to comply with Russia's [[2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute#Demand of payment in rubles|demand that gas be paid for in rubles]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/russian-gas-flows-finland-stop-saturday-says-gasum-2022-05-20/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-61524933 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Three people are wounded, one critically, in a stabbing attack in [[Uvdal]] and [[Nore, Norway|Nore]], [[Norway]]. [[Norwegian Police Service|Police]] say that the attack was due to a domestic dispute between the perpetrator and his wife. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/several-people-stabbed-south-east-norway-police-say-2022-05-20/ (Reuters)]
*An Argentinian court finds the [[Republic of Argentina]] guilty for the 1924 [[Napalpí massacre]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-61519794 (BBC News)]
*One person is killed and eight others wounded after a mass shooting in [[San Bernardino]], [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/san-bernardino-california-los-angeles-shootings-a90003772d658003b5a877cc86c9801c (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*An unusually strong and early [[heat wave]] increases temperatures above {{conv|40|C|F}} in [[Spain]]. [[Seville]] records a temperature of {{conv|41.0|C|F}}, beating its all-time high for May, while the hottest settlement, [[Andújar]], ties the record with {{conv|42.3|C|F}}. Several settlements in [[France]], [[Switzerland]], [[Liechtenstein]] and western [[Austria]] beat all-time high records for the month. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20220520/8281874/espana-supera-40-grados-ano-tercero-mas-madrugador-1920.html (''La Vanguardia'')] [https://elpais.com/espana/2022-05-21/el-calor-extremo-pone-en-alerta-a-11-comunidades-por-temperaturas-de-hasta-40.html (''El País'')] [https://web.archive.org/web/20220521222302/http://www.aemet.es/es/serviciosclimaticos/datosclimatologicos/efemerides_extremos?w=2 (AEMET)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/may/20/spain-braces-for-heat-wave-of-extraordinary-intensity (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.srf.ch/meteo/meteo-stories/hochsommer-im-fruehling-rekordhitze-im-mai (SRF)] [https://www.rts.ch/info/suisse/13111460-record-de-chaleur-pour-un-mois-de-mai-en-suisse-egale-a-viege.html (RTS)] [https://orf.at/stories/3266973/ (ORF)]
*[[Morocco]] records its highest May temperature ever in [[Sidi Slimane, Morocco|Sidi Slimane]], at {{conv|45.7|C|F}}. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2022/05/20/spain-france-heat/ (''The Washington Post'')]
